# Projection

`<fixtures>/hello.tsare`

Quoted text is a field, copied verbatim: a paraphrase of a claim is a new claim.
The indented note under each quote is the projection's own -- what the sentence
stands on, who checks it, and what is still owed.

### F_SCROLL -- fact

> scrolling ten thousand files stays under one frame

  evidence: tool("trace: 8 ms p95 over 200 scrolls") | obligation: check (ready)

### V_FRAME -- value

> frame_ms

  direction: min | unit: "ms" | threshold: 16 | measured_by: "trace" | obligation: measure (ready)

### P_FAST -- proposition

> the browser stays under one frame while scrolling

  from: F_SCROLL | obligation: prove (ready)

### W_FAST -- warrant

> one frame is the budget for interaction

  from: F_SCROLL | to: P_FAST | basis: V_FRAME | obligation: justify (ready)

---

4 obligation(s), 4 ready.
